cfr_sections.reason: A declared title/part connection to rule_targets exists, but rule_targets is absent from this publication index. CFR editions and structural rows must remain explicit; matching section labels alone is unsafe.

comment_attributes.reason: The declared comment_id connection points to comments, which is absent from this publication index. This table retains the attributes; it does not supply the missing comment-body endpoint.

fcc_filings.reason: Each filing can name several proceedings in proceeding_names_json. Connecting it requires explicit JSON-array expansion; a scalar or title match would drop or invent relationships.

fec_relationships.reason: Subject/object IDs are polymorphic and include missing, empty and reported-none observations. Positive edges require value_status, ID status and entity-type guards; collection/source-record keys require JSON extraction. A raw subject_id/object_id equality join is unsafe.
